request.description:
### Get Category by ID

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/categories/:id`

**Access:** 🌐 Public — no authentication required

---

Returns a single category including its parent, subcategories, and the 10 most recent active products.

> 💡 `{{categoryId}}` is saved automatically after running **Create Category**.

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | ✅ | Category ID (positive integer) |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Category retrieved successfully",
  "data": {
    "category_id": 1,
    "category_name": "Clothing",
    "parent": null,
    "children": [...],
    "products": [...]
  }
}
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Message | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Validation error | Invalid category ID format |
| `404 Not Found` | Category not found | No category with given ID |

exec: pm.test("Response has success flag true", function () {

request.description:
### Create Category

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/categories`

**Access:** 🔐 Admin only — requires authentication with Admin role

> Only administrators can create new categories.
> Include `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` with an Admin account.

---

### Request Body (JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | ✅ | 2–100 characters |
| `description` | string | ❌ | Max 500 characters |
| `icon` | string | ❌ | Emoji or icon identifier |
| `parentId` | integer | ❌ | Parent category ID (for subcategories) |
| `displayOrder` | integer | ❌ | Display order (default: 0) |

---

### Success Response — `201 Created`

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 201,
  "message": "Category created successfully",
  "data": {
    "category_id": 5,
    "category_name": "Electronics",
    "description": "Electronic devices and accessories",
    "icon": "📱",
    "display_order": 2
  }
}
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Message | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Validation error | Missing or invalid fields |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Unauthorized | Missing or invalid token |
| `403 Forbidden` | Forbidden | Authenticated user is not an Admin |
| `409 Conflict` | Category already exists | A category with that name already exists |

**Endpoint:** `PUT /api/categories/:id`

**Access:** 🔐 Admin only — requires authentication with Admin role

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | ✅ | Category ID |

| `displayOrder` | integer | Non-negative integer |

| `404 Not Found` | Category not found | No category with given ID |

request.description:
### Delete Category

**Endpoint:** `DELETE /api/categories/:id`

**Access:** 🔐 Admin only — requires authentication with Admin role

> Performs a **soft delete** — the category is marked as deleted but not permanently removed.
> ⚠️ Deletion fails if the category has active products or subcategories.

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | ✅ | Category ID |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Category deleted successfully"
}
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Message | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Category has products and cannot be deleted | Category has active listings |
| `400 Bad Request` | Category has subcategories and cannot be deleted | Category has children |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Unauthorized | Missing or invalid token |
| `403 Forbidden` | Forbidden | Not an Admin |
| `404 Not Found` | Category not found | No category with given ID |
